During that call, reentrant execution can access functions such as `withdraw`, `buy1`, `buy2`, `buy3`, or another `buyOne`, all of which read or modify the shared `balances` mapping. Thus the reported cross-function reentrancy condition exists, with the balance update occurring after the external call.
